hook: Only *40 TMC* of usable water is left in Nagarjuna Sagar, officials say
hook_b: Only *40 TMC* of usable water is left in Nagarjuna Sagar, officials say
tldr: Telangana Retired Engineers Association wants an urgent KRMB meeting after AP drew water from the Nagarjuna Sagar Right Canal.

beats.what: TREA said AP diverted 6,000 cusecs from Nagarjuna Sagar Right Canal on Thursday, citing drinking water, without KRMB permission.
beats.why: Officials say only 40 TMC is available after evaporation losses and keeping levels above the minimum drawdown level.
beats.care: TREA wants the 40 TMC reserved only for the drinking water needs of both states, used in a regulated way.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: TREA also flagged AP's Palnadu Water Grid, saying Telangana was unaware of it, and wants it raised at the Apex Council.

cards.q: Should the 40 TMC be kept only for drinking water?

qs: How long can 40 TMC meet both states' drinking needs?
Who decides releases when KRMB has not met?

facts.t: TREA says AP diverts about *15 TMC* for Chennai's supply from Srisailam.

steps.e: AP draws 6,000 cusecs, cites drinking water
TREA seeks KRMB, Apex Council meet

viz.verdict: Less water left for both states' drinking needs as summer approaches.

learn.t: TMC = thousand million cubic feet, the unit used to measure reservoir water

watch: Whether the Centre convenes a KRMB or Apex Council meeting on the diversion.
